description: This file defines data structures and a class for evaluating approval requests for executing commands, including security checks, allowlist matching, and skill auto-allow logic.

classes.name: ExecApprovalEvaluation
classes.description: Struct representing the result of an approval evaluation, including command details, security status, allowlist matches, and skill allowance.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Asynchronously evaluates a command for approval based on security policies, allowlist, and skill trust.

methods.name: isSkillAutoAllowed
methods.description: Determines if the command resolution is auto-allowed based on trusted skill bins.

methods.name: _testIsSkillAutoAllowed
methods.description: Test method for internal use to check skill auto-allow logic.
